calls.statement:
SELECT 'store' k, store_key::VARCHAR a, store_id::VARCHAR b, store_name c, city d, valid_from::VARCHAR e, valid_to::VARCHAR f, is_current::VARCHAR g FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Palokka%' OR city ILIKE '%Jyv%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'prod', product_key::VARCHAR, sku::VARCHAR, product_name, category, valid_from::VARCHAR, valid_to::VARCHAR, is_current::VARCHAR FROM dim_product WHERE sku=100011
UNION ALL
SELECT 'date', calendar_date::VARCHAR, fiscal_year, fiscal_week::VARCHAR, fiscal_week_start_date::VARCHAR, fiscal_week_end_date::VARCHAR, day_name, '' FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date IN ('2026-10-04','2026-10-08','2026-09-27')

SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=124) AND product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE sku=100011)
ORDER BY week_ending_date DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT (SELECT max(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) maxdate, (SELECT max(week_ending_date) FROM fact_stock_week) maxstock, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) maxsale, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date='2026-10-04') n_oct4, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date='2026-09-27') n_sep27

SELECT d.fiscal_week, sum(f.quantity) sold, count(*) lines, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.store_key=30 AND f.product_key=11 AND f.sale_date>='2026-08-31' AND f.channel_code='ST'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.store_key, f.channel_code, count(*) lines, sum(quantity) qty, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE product_key=11 AND sale_date>='2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.week_ending_date, s.closing_units, s.adjustment_units, (SELECT coalesce(sum(quantity),0) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.store_key=30 AND f.product_key=11 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN s.week_ending_date-6 AND s.week_ending_date) sold
FROM fact_stock_week s WHERE store_key=30 AND product_key=11 AND week_ending_date>='2026-08-01' ORDER BY 1
